translations.web: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
translations.bsb: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
translations.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
translations.asv: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher powers: for there is no power but of God; and the powers that be are ordained of God.
